 Karnali Wins Toss, Elects to Bowl Against Sudurpashchim in NPL
 Ratopati
 November 06, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Karnali has won the toss in the first match to be held on Friday under the third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 Karnali captain Sompal Kami has won the toss against Sudurpashchim in the match at TU International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur and chosen to bowl.
